description.fun: Cryogonal is a living snowflake. It's born in snow clouds, though it's also said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn as Cryogonal. When it warms up it turns to steam and vanishes, then returns to ice when it cools, so it's almost never seen in summer. It snares prey with chains of ice crystals, flash-freezes them and carries them off somewhere unknown.
description.guide: Cryogonal is an Ice-type Pokémon made of ice crystals in the shape of a snowflake. It captures prey with chains of ice and turns to vapour in warm weather. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A living snowflake that snares prey with chains of ice.
